open_points.subject: answer_request request-bound measurement for JSON text fields
open_points.text: After every request bound is checked on the texts as received, as the last step of the fit check, before the actor check and before any handler runs, MUST replace every JSON text the request carries — the json_text of each RequestJsonValue and RequestConstant, the value_schema of every Port and RequestConstant, the guard_value of every EdgeGuard — by its canonical form obtained from canonical_bytes; a NonCanonicalValueError there is invalid_request, so modules below receive only canonical JSON (A01 rule 1).
open_points.other_text: Each JSON text the message carries as a string is measured on its own by canonical_bytes, so the message around it adds no depth to it.
open_points.question: Must each JSON-text bound be measured from its UTF-8 text as received before canonicalization, or from the canonical bytes returned by canonical_bytes?
